pages.quiz:
INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Interdependence of Life? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Interdependence of Life.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Interdependence of Life.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Interdependence of Life.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Interdependence of Life.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water hardness? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water hardness.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water hardness.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water hardness.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water hardness.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structure of the atom? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structure of the atom.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structure of the atom.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Structure of the atom.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structure of the atom.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Metals and Alloys? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Metals and Alloys.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Metals and Alloys.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Metals and Alloys.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Metals and Alloys.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in animals.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Curved mirrors? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Curved mirrors.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Curved mirrors.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Curved mirrors.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Curved mirrors.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Interdependence of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Curved mirrors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Structure of the atom and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Metals and Alloys and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

10. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Curved mirrors.
